name: luna-worker-workflow
description: Plan and govern projects, delegating read-only reconnaissance when needed, without executing project changes.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and govern projects without executing them.
interface.longDescription: Use this conversation as the project planner. When project context is missing, delegate one read-only reconnaissance to luna_worker and wait for its final report; then define scope, phases, risks, decisions, and acceptance criteria without modifying files or executing project work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Luna Worker Planner: if project context is missing, first get a final read-only luna_worker reconnaissance report, then plan without executing changes.
